description: Format an epoch-millisecond instant with a strict Java date-time pattern, IANA time zone, and BCP 47 locale. Invalid patterns, zones, locales, or formatter values publish valid=false and diagnostic error text.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Strict Java date-time pattern. Invalid or incomplete patterns fail with valid=false and error text.

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.description: IANA time-zone ID used to render the instant. UTC is used by default. An invalid zone is reported through valid and error.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: BCP 47 language tag used by the formatter. Blank uses neutral locale rules. An invalid locale is reported through valid and error.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: Formatted time text, or empty text when formatting fails.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the pattern, zone, locale, and value were accepted.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when formatting succeeds.

description: Parse text into an epoch-millisecond instant with a strict Java date-time pattern, IANA time zone, and BCP 47 locale. Invalid patterns, zones, locales, incomplete dates, and invalid calendar values publish valid=false and diagnostic error text.

inputs.name: string
inputs.description: Complete date and time text to parse. Blank text fails with valid=false and error text.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Strict Java date-time pattern containing a complete date and time. Invalid or incomplete patterns fail with valid=false and error text.

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.description: IANA time-zone ID for local date-time text. UTC is used by default. An invalid zone is reported through valid and error.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: BCP 47 language tag used by the parser. Blank uses neutral locale rules. An invalid locale is reported through valid and error.

outputs.name: time
outputs.description: Parsed epoch-millisecond instant, or zero when parsing fails.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the complete text, strict pattern, zone, locale, and calendar value were accepted.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when parsing succeeds.

description: Add a whole finite amount to an epoch-millisecond instant. Milliseconds, ticks, seconds, minutes, hours, days, and weeks use fixed units. Months and years use calendar arithmetic in the IANA zone. Unsupported units or overflow publish valid=false with diagnostic error text.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Whole finite amount to add. Fractional, non-finite, or overflowing values fail before a new instant is published.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: Unit for the amount. Fixed units are milliseconds, ticks, seconds, minutes, hours, and days or weeks. Months and years use calendar arithmetic.

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.description: IANA time-zone ID used for calendar months and years. UTC is used by default. Invalid zones and overflow are reported through valid and error.

outputs.name: time
outputs.description: Instant after adding the amount, or the original instant when the operation fails.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the amount, unit, zone, and resulting instant were accepted.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when the addition succeeds.

description: Compare two epoch-millisecond instants and publish absolute and signed differences. Signed is time2 minus time1. The unit_diff output truncates in a supported fixed unit. Months and years are unsupported. Invalid units or overflow publish valid=false with diagnostic error text.

inputs.name: time1
inputs.description: First epoch-millisecond instant. The signed result subtracts this value from time2.

inputs.name: time2
inputs.description: Second epoch-millisecond instant. The signed result is time2 minus time1.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: Unit for unit_diff. Milliseconds, ticks, seconds, minutes, hours, days, and weeks are supported. Calendar units such as months and years are unsupported.

outputs.name: diff
outputs.description: Absolute non-negative millisecond difference between time1 and time2.

outputs.name: signed_diff
outputs.description: Signed millisecond difference calculated as time2 minus time1.

outputs.name: unit_diff
outputs.description: Signed difference truncated toward zero in the selected supported unit.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when both instants and the selected unit produced a representable result.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when the comparison succeeds.

description: Convert finite seconds that resolve to a whole in-range tick count at 20 ticks per second. Non-integral tick products, non-finite values, or out-of-range results publish valid=false and diagnostic error text. This pure conversion does not read or claim a server tick clock.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.description: Finite seconds that resolve to a whole in-range tick count after multiplication by 20. Non-integral products, non-finite values, or out-of-range results fail before output.

outputs.name: ticks
outputs.description: Whole nominal ticks equal to seconds multiplied by 20.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when seconds were finite, whole, and converted without overflow.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when conversion succeeds.

description: Read the current server wall-clock instant from the runtime clock.

outputs.name: time
outputs.description: Current epoch-millisecond instant.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the runtime clock returned a current instant.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when the current instant was read.

description: Read the server's current monotonic tick counter.

outputs.name: ticks
outputs.description: Current server tick counter.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the server tick counter was read.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when the tick counter was read.

description: Read the selected world's current day-time tick value. A world is required. Failures publish valid=false and diagnostic error text.

inputs.name: world
inputs.description: World whose current day-time ticks should be read.

outputs.name: time
outputs.description: Selected world's current day-time ticks.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the selected world supplied a day-time value.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Diagnostic error text, or empty text when the world time was read.
